source.title: 2019 Salary Resolutions (2019-01-03 Town Board - Full Minutes, CivicClerk)

note: Board-authorized annual salaries set by resolutions 2019-9 through 2019-16. Schedules carried here: Boards, Elected Officials, General Fund, Highway, Police, Sewer / Scavenger Waste, Street Lighting, Water District. This is authorized pay, not actual pay, and it is the schedule as adopted in January: a mid-year salary resolution changes what a position is paid without changing this file.
